# support: donor-only (raven-pf at 4adc24a2 has no fragment model)
# `scrub ... fragment reassemble` in fragment.conf means the port rule is
# applied to the reassembled datagram. The rows below are the fragments in
# arrival order; each fragment's verdict is the verdict of the reassembled
# datagram. A non-first fragment alone carries no TCP/UDP ports. The final
# field is the byte offset and the More-Fragments flag, not the 8-byte units
# now direction interface proto source sport destination dport length flags expected disposition fragment
